about_short_description.short_description: StafBook is a People-First HR Partner that assists businesses in easing HR as well as enabling leaders to build engaged and top teams.

product.name: StafBook Dashboard (Web Apps)
product.description: A web-based platform for managing employee data, attendance, payroll, leave, reimbursements, and tasks in one integrated system.

product.name: StafBook Mobile (Mobile ESS)
product.description: A mobile application that allows employees to manage attendance, leave, reimbursements, approvals, and access payroll information remotely.

product.name: Attendance and Shift Management
product.description: A system to schedule, monitor shifts, record attendance, and calculate lateness and overtime automatically.

product.name: Leave Management
product.description: A system to customize and manage employee leave, sick, and permission policies through an employee self-service portal.

product.name: Reimbursement Management
product.description: An integrated system to record, review, and manage employee reimbursement policies and claims.

product.name: Payroll Management
product.description: A system to customize payroll components and automatically calculate salaries including taxes and social security contributions.
